WITH event_rates AS (
    SELECT b.link_to_event,
           AVG(CAST(b.spent AS REAL) / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_spending_rate
    FROM budget AS b
    JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
    GROUP BY b.link_to_event
),
type_rates AS (
    SELECT e.type,
           AVG(er.avg_spending_rate) AS avg_spending_rate
    FROM event_rates AS er
    JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = er.link_to_event
    GROUP BY e.type
)
SELECT type,
       avg_spending_rate,
       avg_spending_rate / NULLIF(AVG(avg_spending_rate) OVER (), 0) AS relative_to_mean
FROM type_rates;
